relationships.subject: MEG3
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicated that MEG3 downregulates the expression of TRPV1 in CFA-induced rats.

relationships.subject: MEG3
relationships.evidence_quote: These results indicate that intrathecal injection of a MEG3-overexpressing lentivirus significantly alleviated inflammatory pain in CFA-induced rats.

relationships.subject: capsazepine
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with TRPV1 antagonist significantly alleviated CFA-induced inflammatory pain and decreased pain-related behavior in these rats.

relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Moreover, VEGF promotes the activation and upregulates the expression of transient receptor potential vanilloid 1 (TRPV1).

key_findings: MEG3 decreased and TRPV1 increased in DRG and spinal dorsal horn of CFA rats.
Intrathecal MEG3 overexpression lowered TRPV1 and relieved pain; TRPV1 antagonist capsazepine also relieved pain.
